sessions.table_1: Prompts: the number of prompts you sent in the session (not Claude's messages). Many sessions have just one prompt, so this is often small.
sessions.table_2: In / Out: input tokens (excluding cache) and output tokens. Their prices differ a lot, so they're shown separately. Total tokens includes cache reads/writes.
sessions.table_3: Cost: estimated from the price table, priced per request with its own model. “no pricing” means the model isn't in the price table (it is not $0).
sessions.table_4: Model: a session can switch between several models, so every model is shown as a chip; open the session details to see in / out per model. The gray chip is the effort (if any). Effort doesn't change the per-token price.
sessions.table_5: Select rows with the checkboxes to Archive / Restore / Trash in bulk. If an action fails, a red message shows the server error and the failed rows stay selected so you can retry.
sessions.filters_1: Filters are remembered for next time. ★ Starred shows only starred sessions; Group by project groups by folder. Set the default view in Settings.
sessions.filters_2: The status list shows counts, e.g. “Archived (0)”. Models are ordered strongest to weakest; projects by most recent use.
sessions.expiring_1: Claude Code automatically deletes transcripts after a number of days without use (30 by default). The warning above the table shows how many sessions are about to be deleted; Archive to keep them (restorable any time). Click ✕ to hide it for 24 hours.
sessions.shortcuts_1: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd>: search the content of every session (a “Search content” button appears in the top bar if the server supports it).
sessions.shortcuts_2: In the session details: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>F</kbd> find in session, <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> jump between prompts, <kbd>Esc</kbd> close.

usage.modes_1: Billing: counts subagents too (sub-tasks Claude runs on its own, including sidechains and files in subagents/). This is the number closest to your real invoice.
usage.modes_2: Conversation: counts only the main conversation between you and Claude, excluding subagents. It's usually lower than Billing; the difference is the subagent share.
usage.calc_1: Tokens come from each message's usage, de-duplicated by message id + requestId.
usage.calc_2: Cost is an estimate based on list prices (edit them in “Pricing…”) and may differ from your invoice. Models without pricing show “no pricing”, not $0.
usage.calc_3: Dates and times use the {tz} time zone.
usage.calc_4: 5-hour block: starts at the time of the first request (rounded down to the minute) and lasts 5 hours.
usage.calc_5: Chart metric: cost, Input, Output, Input + Output (no cache) or total including cache.
usage.old_retention: Claude Code automatically deletes transcripts after {days} days without use.
usage.old_oldest: The oldest day still on disk: {day}.
usage.old_frozen: {n} older days no longer have source files; they're kept from saved history so totals don't drop.
usage.old_generic: Claude Code automatically deletes transcripts after a number of days without use; archive sessions to avoid deletion.

workspace.shortcuts_1: Double-click a pane title: maximize / restore.
workspace.shortcuts_2: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>arrow</kbd>: switch pane (<kbd>↑</kbd> on the top row: move to the toolbar).
workspace.newpane_1: Choose a source, a folder and (optionally) a session to resume. You can pick a Model and Effort; leave them empty to use Claude's defaults. Your last choices are remembered.
workspace.newpane_2: The </> button on the pane title (and in the session details) opens that folder in VS Code.
workspace.cli_1: Type <kbd>/help</kbd> in a pane for the full list. Handy ones: <kbd>/model</kbd> switch model, <kbd>/compact</kbd> compact context, <kbd>/resume</kbd> resume an old session.
workspace.cli_2: <kbd>@</kbd> mentions a file in the folder; <kbd>Esc</kbd> interrupts a running Claude; <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> switches mode.

general.1: <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd>: search session content. The theme button cycles auto / light / dark.
general.2: Settings (⚙): add a .claude folder when you move to another machine, switch text / icons, hide filters, stats, columns and panels.
general.3: The top bar shows the session count; hover it to see the last scan time. “Rescan” forces a scan right away.
